description: String concatenation in a feature condition uses constants from the selected stage (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.value = $S ++ ""
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%const $S "a"
%rule text f? A

```
